files.body:
# garden/v3's module path. Deploy status is deliberately NOT recorded in this file, and
# neither is a claim about whether anyone has decided to deploy it.
#
# This file ships on chain exactly as written the moment garden/v3 is deployed, and a realm
# cannot be edited afterwards. garden/v2/gnomod.toml said "NOT deployed" in this same spot,
# was deployed hours later, and now carries that false line permanently on chain -- see that
# file's own corrected comment, DECISIONS.md ("Do not write deployment status into a file
# that gets deployed") and STATUS.md:142-145. Whether and when this has been deployed lives
# in the repo root's DECISIONS.md and STATUS.md, both of which can still be corrected after
# the fact; the authority above both is the chain itself (`vm/qfile` on this path).
#
# The module path mirrors garden/garden.gno, garden/v2/garden.gno, hollowmere/v1 and
# arena/v1: the deploy key's own address namespace, not a name, because `gnotchi` is not
# registerable today (r/sys/names, team-held controller -- see realms/garden/NOTES.md).
# Whoever deploys this should re-check that this path is still right first.
#
# THREE THINGS TO CHECK BEFORE DEPLOYING THIS, all recorded in DESIGN.md and none
# discoverable from this line alone:
#
#  0. THE THREE SALE CONSTANTS AT THE VERY TOP OF garden.gno -- saleFeeRecipient,
#     saleFeeRateBps (basis points of the price) and saleFeeFloorUgnot (ugnot) -- are the
#     owner's decision of 2026-10-11 for the onyx testnet, and init() still refuses to run if
#     any of them is edited to a value that cannot work (DESIGN.md section 9.7). Re-read them
#     before deploying: once deployed they can never change, because there is no fee setter,
#     no steward and no treasury change, on purpose (section 9.6). They are testnet values;
#     a mainnet deploy would be a fresh realm with fresh numbers decided then.
#  1. adminAddress in garden.gno is a compiled-in constant and is today the DISPOSABLE
#     TESTNET deploy key (DECISIONS.md: "Never a mainnet key."). It is correct for onyx and
#     wrong for anywhere real. Change that one constant before deploying anywhere that
#     matters -- it cannot be changed afterwards, and there is no admin-transfer function.
#  2. This realm imports NOTHING of this project's own. Unlike arena/v1, which cannot
#     resolve a battle unless garden/v2 is live at the exact path it imports, garden/v3 has
#     no cross-realm dependency at all and can be deployed to any chain on its own. The
#     consequence runs the other way and is in DESIGN.md section 6.3: the already-deployed
#     arena/v1 imports garden/v2 immutably, so a gnome adopted here cannot use arena/v1.
module = "gno.land/r/g1r4aw43kagaaquhegxw6xr346h9f2qu2ezf0jar/garden/v3"
gno = "0.9"

tx.memo: garden/v3: sale constants per owner 2026-10-11; testnet
